# Original synthetic WICI fixtures

MIT. Created from scratch by `scripts/prepare_synthetic_fixtures.py` using the application contract. No captured response, source document, measurement, vehicle history or satellite image is retained. Field names, enumerations and API hostnames are contract identifiers; all observations and entities are invented. The GFM browser preset ID matches an application constant, but its response and checkerboard image are synthetic. These tests do not verify live service availability.
